# netactuate_metric_names (Data Source)

Reads Metric Names visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_metric_names" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `metrics` (List of Object) Metric catalog entries sorted by metric name. API keys beginning with double underscores are excluded. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))
- `time_window` (List of Object) Time window returned by the metric catalog endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_window))
